Maine U.S. Senate results

Live results:Election nightUpdated Nov 4, 2026, 1:56 PM

Race to watch ✪

Sen. Susan Collins, the only Senate Republican to represent a state that former Democratic Vice President Kamala Harris carried in 2024, has been considered one of the chamber’s most vulnerable GOP incumbents in all five of her reelection campaigns. Democrats have picked Troy Jackson to challenge her. Jackson is a former logger and former Republican who went on to serve as president of the state Senate as a Democrat. Jackson was chosen by delegates at a state convention in July to replace Graham Platner as the Democratic nominee when Platner withdrew following sexual assault allegations.

AP Decision Team updates
Nov. 04, 6:07 AM
At the time the race was called for Jackson, Collins would have had to get nearly 60% of the race's remaining votes in order to notch a win. Many of the largest jurisdictions where votes have yet to be counted, including South Portland and Scarborough, favored Kamala Harris by significant margins in the 2024 election.
Nov. 04, 5:45 AM
Susan Collins has conceded the race, but the AP has still not declared a winner. The AP calls a race only when it’s determined there is no scenario that would allow a trailing candidate to close the gap.
Nov. 04, 12:53 AM
Polls are about to close in Maine. In the 2024 election, the AP first reported results from Maine 44 minutes after polls closed. By 3:13 p.m. ET on the day after Election Day, about 90% of the vote had been counted.

Areas to watch
Few voters anywhere in the nation are as idiosyncratic as those in Maine’s rural north, a heavily French-speaking region with a populist streak. Both Republican Sen. Susan Collins and her Democratic rival, Troy Jackson, hail from Aroostook County. If Jackson can cut into Collins’ longstanding strength there, it’s a sign voters may be ready for a change.

AP's guide to this race

When to expect results
In the 2024 general election, the AP first reported results at 8:44 p.m. ET, or 44 minutes after polls closed. About 50% of the total vote had been counted by 12:54 a.m. ET, and counting stopped for the night at 4:11 a.m. ET. By 3:13 p.m. ET the day after Election Day, about 90% of the vote had been counted.
How votes are cast
About 36% of all ballots cast in Maine’s 2022 election, when the 2022 race for governor was held, were cast early or by absentee ballot.
Turnout last midterm
676,819 votes were cast in the 2022 race for governor in Maine.

When the nation waits for results, who do you trust?

For 178 years, AP has been the steady voice America turns to on election night. Our reporters, election analysts and graphics journalists simply tell you who won — no spin, no bias, just facts. We're not owned by billionaires. We don't have an editorial agenda. We just count votes and report results, the same way we've done since 1848.

Democracy itself depends on having one trusted source that puts facts above everything else.

About AP’s election results and race calls

The Associated Press first tabulated vote counts in U.S. elections in 1848 and today gathers election results from local election officials in thousands of races nationwide. Results are reported as soon as they are available. AP’s Decision Team declares winners when certain the trailing candidates no longer have a path to victory. Vote margin shift at the reporting unit level reflects two-party vote share.
